titleZh: 冰草约课 · 课程管理后台（React 16.3）

guide.title: React 16.3 without pretending Hooks exist
guide.titleZh: 不假装 Hooks 存在，也能接住同一套能力
intro: React 16.3 has context, refs, and fragments, but no Hooks. The legacy entry provides context, class-based bindings, and render props without requiring a second application architecture.
The business outcomes are identical to the React 19 page: duplicate-name lookup, teacher creation, conflict rejection, and schedule updates.
introZh: React 16.3 有 context、ref 与 Fragment，但没有 Hooks。legacy 入口提供基于 context、class 与 render props 的绑定，不需要再复制一套应用架构。
业务结果与 React 19 页面一致：重名查找、新增老师、冲突拒绝与课表更新都不打折。

steps.title: Render through legacy APIs
steps.titleZh: 使用 legacy API 渲染
steps.body: ReactDOM.render and PlingProvider mount a real React 16.3 root. There is no React 19 compatibility shim silently running underneath.
steps.bodyZh: ReactDOM.render 与 PlingProvider 挂载真实的 React 16.3 根节点，没有偷偷运行的 React 19 兼容层。

steps.title: Bind elements with render props
steps.titleZh: 用 render props 绑定元素
steps.body: PlingScope and PlingRecord hand back refs. Their class-based binding keeps registration in sync with component lifecycle.
steps.bodyZh: PlingScope 与 PlingRecord 返回 ref；基于 class 的绑定让注册状态与组件生命周期保持同步。

steps.title: Keep execution out of React
steps.body: The task runtime is created in componentDidMount and destroyed on unmount. React renders progress; it does not reimplement lookup or business validation.
steps.bodyZh: 任务运行时在 componentDidMount 创建，卸载时销毁。React 负责渲染进度，不重写查找或业务校验。

steps.title: Use the shared assistant
steps.body: The legacy dock exposes the same Activity and Debug panels as the Hooks adapter.
steps.bodyZh: legacy 助手入口提供与 Hooks 适配器相同的最近操作和调试面板。

guide.note: This example is the compatibility proof, not a reduced feature set. The same five tasks and the same failure path are available.
guide.noteZh: 这个示例是兼容性证明，不是功能缩水版；五个任务与失败路径都完整保留。
